text:
Rae: Deploy-bot blocked the canary promote for edge-router v5.1.0-canary. Artifact verify failed: manifest validation error (signed manifest mismatch). Change window expires in ~22m, need a quick call: pin to previous canary or attempt an in-window rebuild+upload with cache-bust? Logs below.

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/edge-router@sha256:aa3f9c
error: manifest verification failed: signed-manifest-digest mismatch
expected manifest sha256: aa3f9c
observed manifest sha256 (registry-proxy): ba4d55
action: promotion blocked; manual decision required

CI-bot: runner upload logs show S3-proxy returned 500 during final commit step and the registry accepted a shorter manifest. Multipart commit appears partial; resulting manifest digest differs from what CI computed locally.

Zoe: S3-proxy 500s were around 06:12 UTC according to monitoring. If we retry upload we risk hitting the same transient. Pinning to last good canary sha256:77a1b2 keeps the change window and avoids chasing infra flakiness.

Marcus: I agree with pin. I'll do a manual promote and watch smoke for 15m. Deploy-bot supports: 
```
/deploybot promote --image sha256:77a1b2 --env canary --meta "pin-manifest-mismatch"
```
I'll abort if canary http_5xx > 0.7% or latency p95 jumps > 120ms.

Rae: If we pin, please update release-notes/urgent/drafts with a one-liner and include rollback steps and a link to the rebuild PR once it's open. E.g.: 
"Canary promotion deferred due to signed-manifest digest mismatch caused by registry-proxy partial commit; pinned to previous canary sha256:77a1b2 while rebuild + verified upload are scheduled."

Infra-bot: seeing increased 5xx rate from s3-proxy-us-west at 06:11-06:15 UTC. Filing INC-2026-21 and queuing proxy restart + investigation. ETA purge/retry jobs in ~8m.

CI-bot: Recommend creating a rebuilt image with --cache-bust and uploading with --atomic-commit flag; then run a verify job that pulls the uploaded manifest from the same registry-proxy and compares sha256 before any promote. CI snippet: 
```
./ci/build-image --tag=edge-router:canary-rebuild --cache-bust
./ci/upload --atomic-commit --verify-sha256
```

Marcus: Manual promote command queued. Deploy-bot: queued -> promoting -> smoke-run. Posting status here.

Zoe: I'll open the rebuild PR and include the verify stage that downloads the manifest after upload and asserts sha256 equality before allowing promote. Also will link the incident INC-2026-21 in the PR.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run started. Will post pass/fail.

Marcus: Smoke @ +7m: error-rate 0.18%, p95 latency stable. Watching remaining 8m. Temporary alert set: canary_manifest_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

Deploy-bot: smoke-run passed. Canary promoted to sha256:77a1b2 (manual pin). Promotion complete.

Rae: Thanks. Action items: Marcus manual promote + watch, Zoe open rebuild PR with --atomic-commit + verify stage, Infra to investigate s3-proxy and attach logs to INC-2026-21, CI to block automatic promote until verify step is in place. Rae will update release-notes/urgent/drafts and notify PMs. Reopen thread if post-promote anomalies appear.
